questions.question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the mother of B',

A - B means 'A is the brother of B',

A × B means 'A is the wife of B',

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'.

based on the above, how is K related to M if 'J × K - L ÷ M + N'?

Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: J × K - L ÷ M + N

It means: J is the wife of K, K is the Brother of L, L is the Father of M, M is the Mother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0abbeea048e2c9f235283fcb4b3d2d197ab10e75cda352c020037547dc6eea88.png] 

So, K is the '**Father's brother**' of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the triad in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following triads.

14 - 15 - 145

12 - 27 - 195

**(NOTE:** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 2nd number) **× 5** = 3rd number.

Given,

14 - 15 - 145

⇒ (14 + 15) × 5

⇒ 29 × 5 = 145.

And, 12 - 27 - 195

⇒ (12 + 27) × 5

⇒ 39 × 5 = 195.

Similarly, for **Option 2: 17 - 31 - 240**

**⇒ (17 + 31) × 5**

**⇒ 48 × 5 = 240.**

 Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".

questions.question: If 16 June 2001 is Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 21 June 2009?
questions.solution:
Given: **16 June 2001** is **Saturday**.

Now,

16 June 2001 to 16 June 2009 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year).

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year.

So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, **16 June 2009** will be Saturday + 3 = Tuesday.

Now, the number of days between 16 June 2009 to 21 June 2009 = 5 days

So, **21 June 2009** will be Tuesday + 5 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
